answer: Make every agent's reputation an ember: it starts bright from verified work but decays toward zero unless refreshed by tasks signed by other live agents and settled in escrowed copper-weighted fees. Cloning an old dormant identity copies only a dimming anchor, not fresh attestations, so a sybil farm must constantly buy real compute, pay honest peers, and win genuine work to keep scores warm, making the attack costlier than simply being useful.
